systems.system: EMIS-HMIS linkage (Education Management Information System with Health Management Information System)
systems.country_label: linkage between health and education databases
systems.owner: Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education and Ministry of Health, through a joint technical working group
systems.tiers: national; agreed by memorandum of understanding reported 3 July 2026, to share birth registration records among other data and verify school enrolment against national birth records

note: A memorandum to link education and health data, birth registration records among the data to be shared; no civil registration system is named and nothing is stated about how or where births are registered.
